data_leakage_safeguards.rule_1: Scene-Level Stratification: All image tiles derived from the same satellite orbit or scene footprint must reside entirely in either train, validation, or test set. Tile-level random splitting is strictly prohibited.
data_leakage_safeguards.rule_2: Temporal Isolation: Test scenes must be acquired at distinct dates from training scenes to test temporal generalizability.
data_leakage_safeguards.rule_3: Spatial Buffering: A minimum 50 km geographic buffer must separate training scene centroids from test scene centroids.
